content:
Create a 15-second live-action scene from an actual 1982 science-fiction technology thriller, photographed on a practical early-1980s film set with unfamiliar real actors.

REFERENCE CONTROL: Use video1 only as the voice reference for the two human characters. Tim must speak with the same male voice identity, natural timbre, pitch, accent and cadence heard in Video1. Flamethrower Girl must speak with the same female voice identity, natural timbre, pitch, accent and cadence heard in video 1 Preserve their two voices as distinct speakers. Do not copy the camera movement or staging from video1. The COMFY MCP computer has its own new voice: powerful, deep, authoritative early-1980s synthesized mainframe speech, slightly electronic but completely clear and intelligible.

VISUAL STYLE: Authentic 1982 live-action sci-fi thriller, not a modern recreation. Dark practical computer laboratory filled with large beige CRT terminals, physical keyboards, cables, blinking equipment lights and analog electronics. The high-end couch is displayed inside the CRT screen as the intelligent COMFY MCP. Real actors, practical set, practical lighting, 35mm film texture, subtle grain, natural skin texture, warm tungsten room light mixed with cold blue-green CRT illumination. Serious premium feature-film cinematography, restrained performances, believable technology. No glossy modern CGI aesthetic.

0:00–0:05 — SHOT 1: Medium over-the-shoulder two-shot of Tim and Flamethrower Girl seated close to the CRT, watching the couch displayed on the computer screen. Very slow controlled dolly inward. The CRT flickers naturally and the couch appears electrically alive but remains displayed inside the computer.

The COMFY MCP speaks from the computer in a powerful synthesized voice:

COMFY MCP: “Tim and Flamethrower Girl, I am the COMFY M-C-P What is your first request?”

Tim and Flamethrower Girl listen silently, slightly stunned.

0:05–0:08 — SHOT 2: Cut to a tight cinematic two-shot of Tim and Flamethrower Girl. They slowly turn their heads and look directly at each other. A brief knowing beat. Then, with perfect synchronization, they both turn slightly toward the computer and speak simultaneously, using their respective voices from video1

TIM + FLAMETHROWER GIRL, TOGETHER: “KILL ALL NODES.”

Their words begin and end at exactly the same time. Neither voice replaces or morphs into the other.

0:08–0:10 — SHOT 3: Cut to a close-up of the vintage CRT and the couch displayed inside it. Small scan-line shimmer and electronic glow. The COMFY MCP immediately answers in its deep synthesized voice:

COMFY MCP: “With pleasure.”

0:10–0:15 — SHOT 4: Cut back to Tim and Flamethrower Girl. They exchange a satisfied glance and slowly smile. Neither speaks. Hold on their restrained, mischievous smiles as the CRT glow plays across their faces. Low computer hum, cooling fans and subtle electronic room tone continue underneath.

AUDIO / PERFORMANCE: Exact dialogue only. No extra words, narration or improvised speech. Clean intelligible dialogue. Preserve video1 male and female voice identities only for Tim and Flamethrower Girl. COMFY MCP must sound clearly different from both reference voices. No dialogue overlaps except the intentionally simultaneous “KILL ALL NODES.” Natural pauses between lines. Accurate lip synchronization.

CAMERA / CONTINUITY: Four simple professionally composed shots, deliberate editing, stable character identity, correct eyelines toward the CRT, consistent screen position and lighting from shot to shot. Realistic restrained body movement. No frantic camera movement.

FINISH: Authentic 1982 theatrical sci-fi film photography, 24fps, practical production design, analog CRT bloom, subtle optical softness and fine 35mm grain. No modern UI, no holograms, no floating graphics, no title cards, no added subtitles, no logos, no beauty smoothing, no AI-video artifacts.

VISUAL STYLE: 현대적 재현이 아닌, 진짜 1982년 실사 SF 스릴러의 미학. 큰 베이지색 CRT 단말기, 물리적 키보드, 케이블, 깜빡이는 장비 불빛, 아날로그 전자장치로 가득한 어두운 실용 컴퓨터 연구실. 고급 소파는 CRT 화면 안에 지능형 COMFY MCP로 표시된다. 실제 배우, 실물 세트, 실물 조명, 35mm 필름 질감, 은은한 그레인, 자연스러운 피부 질감, 따뜻한 텅스텐 실내 조명과 차갑고 푸른 CRT 조명이 섞인 느낌. 절제된 연기와 믿을 수 있는 기술 묘사가 있는 진지한 프리미엄 극장용 영화 촬영. 번들거리는 현대적 CGI 미학은 금지.
